_comment: Tab Cast built-in site rules. Your own rules (Settings > Site rules) are added on top of these. Fields: see README.md#site-rules.

rules.name: YouTube (its web player streams in a way the TV can't replay; yt-dlp asks YouTube for a castable HLS/MP4 link)
rules._ytdlpTryFirst: visionos (YouTube's Apple Vision Pro app) returns the HLS master with all qualities and needs neither YouTube's player script nor its JavaScript challenge, which took most of a minute in QuickJS on the Tab S2 (2026-11-14). If it fails (age check, signed-in cookies, a YouTube change), yt-dlp runs again with its default clients.

rules.name: Vimeo: its web player loads its own segment format (catching finds only pieces), and since 2026 yt-dlp needs a login for vimeo.com pages but not for the embedded player, so yt-dlp gets the player URL
Dailymotion: yt-dlp needs browser impersonation (curl_cffi), which the Android build lacks, so Share opens the page and the video is caught there
